title: Recovery Station: securing the right clinical space in East Maitland
location: Suite B, 66 King Street, East Maitland
excerpt: After six months searching for clinical and office space, Recovery Station engaged YOS to assess opportunities, negotiate commercial terms and secure a suitable East Maitland tenancy.
challenge: After six months searching for new clinical and office premises around Maitland, Recovery Station needed a way forward. Suitable opportunities were being taken quickly, and the team had repeatedly missed out.
solution: Recovery Station engaged Your Office Space in March 2026 to manage the search, negotiate the commercial terms and help keep the leasing process moving. After considering five potential properties, the business signed a lease in August for approximately 100 m² at Suite B, 66 King Street, East Maitland.

sections.heading: The challenge: finding suitable space in a competitive market
paragraphs: Recovery Station needed more than an available office. The premises had to support clinical appointments, provide accessible entry and give the team a practical foundation for its operations.

The search was also taking time away from running the business. After six months of looking, finding and securing the right opportunity required consistent attention and close communication with local agents.

sections.heading: The opportunity: a larger tenancy became the right-sized space
paragraphs: Through its established agent network, Your Office Space identified a property that was initially too large for Recovery Station’s requirements.
When an opportunity arose to split the tenancy, YOS secured Recovery Station the first opportunity to consider the smaller space before it went to market.
The resulting tenancy offered approximately 100 m² within an established medical centre, including:
bullets: Accessible entry directly from the car park.

sections.heading: A location with practical advantages
paragraphs: Its main-road position, opposite a school, provided visibility and passing traffic. The medical-centre setting also offered the potential to build relationships with nearby healthcare providers.
These were advantages of the location, rather than confirmed referral or business-growth outcomes.

sections.heading: The negotiations: keeping the process moving
paragraphs: Your Office Space managed the commercial negotiations and maintained regular communication with the agent. With the building owner overseas, that coordination helped keep discussions and decisions progressing.
The agreed outcome included a successful rent-free period and landlord works agreed before lease execution.

Negotiations also addressed lease options and release provisions intended to safeguard Recovery Station’s future position. Recovery Station completed the final lease review and retained control of the decision to proceed.

sections.heading: The outcome: a signed lease and a practical foundation
paragraphs: By August 2026, Recovery Station had secured premises suited to its clinical and office requirements.

Existing clinical rooms, reception and accessible entry gave the business a useful starting point. YOS also connected the team with contacts for fitout, furniture, cleaning and other practical aspects of the transition.
The result was a property process that Recovery Station could move forward with while continuing to focus on its core business.
